physics_goals.value: Precisely characterize different types of neutrino interactions and study the physical processes that govern them

physics_goals.quote: MINERvA's data will be of great use to neutrino experiments such as MINOS, NOvA and LBNE that study how neutrinos oscillate, or change types.
physics_goals.value: Provide neutrino-nucleus interaction data used by oscillation experiments such as MINOS and NOvA to control systematic uncertainties

summary.plain: A compact, finely sliced detector at Fermilab that measured exactly how neutrinos bounce off different atomic nuclei, data that other neutrino experiments need to interpret their own results.
summary.technical: Neutrino-nucleus cross-section experiment in the NuMI near-detector hall at Fermilab, 1-10 GeV energy range, using passive nuclear targets (graphite, iron, lead, water) alongside a plastic-scintillator tracker; took data 2010 to 26 February 2019.
